
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/23772104" title="发布于 2026-11-25 01:34">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于AScript的Go脚本语言发布啦</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-first-child="" data-pid="SaIXRFSp">AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行引擎，支持扩展多种脚本语言，已实现<code>C#/Python3/SQL/JavaScript/Lua</code>语言，加上当前发布的<code>Go</code>语言，一共支持6种脚本语言。</p>
<h2>一、介绍</h2>
<p data-pid="5qF_OSqi">支持<code>Go</code>基础语法和数据类型，已内置&nbsp;<code>fmt</code>、<code>strconv</code>、<code>sync</code>、<code>regexp</code>、<code>time</code>&nbsp;等常用标准库。</p>
<p data-pid="TWOq8ep_">1）数据类型</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="TWOq8ep_">整型：<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>/int32/int8/int16/int64/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">uint</span>/uint32/uint8/uint16/uint64/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">byte</span></span></li>
<li data-pid="TWOq8ep_">浮点型：<span class="cnblogs_code">float32/float64</span></li>
<li data-pid="TWOq8ep_">布尔类型：<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span></span></li>
<li data-pid="TWOq8ep_">字符/字符串类型：<span class="cnblogs_code">rune/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span></span></li>
<li data-pid="TWOq8ep_">其他：<span class="cnblogs_code">any</span></li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">2）运算符</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">算术运算符：加(+)、减(-)，乘(*)、除(/)，取余(%)</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">位运算符：与(&amp;)、或(|)、非(^)、左移(&lt;&lt;)、右移(&gt;&gt;)、与非(&amp;^)</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">比较运算符：相等(==)、不等(!=)、小于(&lt;)、大于(&gt;)、小于或等于(&lt;=)、大于或等于(&gt;=)</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">逻辑运算符：并且(&amp;&amp;)、或者(||)、非(!)</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">赋值运算符：=、:=、+=、-=、*=、/=、%=、&amp;=、|=、^=、&lt;&lt;=、&gt;&gt;=</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">自增（支持前置和后置）：++</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">自减（支持前置和后置）：--</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">索引：[ ]</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">切片：[:]</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">取地址（前置）：&amp;</li>
<li data-pid="A4iKZJ5T">解引用（前置）：*</li>
</ul>
<p data-pid="QTeqX2P1">3）字符串</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="r05Ivm4Y">字符串使用单引号&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span></span>&nbsp;或双引号&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hello</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span>&nbsp;均可；</li>
<li data-pid="-UyXClDe">支持转义：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">\n \r \t \\ \<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> \'</span></span>&nbsp;等；</li>
<li data-pid="YJTIVgp8">支持反引号包裹的原始字符串（不做任何转义处理），推荐用于正则：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">`\d+`</span>&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2>二、安装</h2>
<p>通过&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">nuget</span>&nbsp;安装&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">AScript</span>&nbsp;包</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">package AScript
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span>-package AScript.Lang.Go</pre>
</div>
<h2>三、使用说明</h2>
<ul>
<li data-pid="HziMAcP6">命名空间：<code>using AScript.Lang.Go</code></li>
</ul>
<h3>3.1 注册语言</h3>
<p>程序启动时全局添加go语言脚本实例：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Script.Langs.Set(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, GoLang.Instance);</pre>
</div>
<h3>3.2 条件语句</h3>
<p>语法：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> init; condition { ... } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> condition { ... } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>支持带初始化语句写法：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> x := <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>; x &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var b int
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">if a &gt; 0 {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    b = 1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">} else if a &lt; 0 {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    b = -1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">} else {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    b = 0
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">b</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h3>3.3 循环语句</h3>
<p>关键字&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span></span>&nbsp;，支持5种形式：</p>
<p>1）传统for循环：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> init; condition; post { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>2）while型循环：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> condition { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>3）无限循环（由内部中断循环）：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>4）range循环（map）：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> k, v := range mapvalue { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>5）range循环（数组/切片）：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span>&nbsp;item := range arr { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 传统 for 循环
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for i := 0; i &lt; 10; i++ {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// while 型 for
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for i &lt; 10 {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    i++
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 无限循环
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    break
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    continue
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// range 循环
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for k, v := range m {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for item := range arr {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>
</div>
<h3>3.4 switch语句</h3>
<p data-pid="bmeValxd">注：不支持&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">fallthrough</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var x = 3
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var result int
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">switch x {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">case 1:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    result = 1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">case 2, 3:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    result = 2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">default:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    result = 0
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">result</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h3>3.5 定义函数</h3>
<p>使用&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">func</span>&nbsp;关键字定义函数：</p>
<p>1）有返回值：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">func 函数名(参数1 类型, 参数2 类型, ...) 返回类型 { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>2）多返回值：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">func 函数名(参数1 类型, ...) (返回类型1, 返回类型2, ...) { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>3）命名返回值：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">func 函数名(参数1 类型, ...) (变量名 类型) { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>4）无返回值：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">func 函数名(参数1 类型, 参数2 类型, ...) { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>5）匿名函数：函数名为空</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 函数声明
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func add(a int, b int) int {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a + b
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 无返回值
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func log(msg string) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    fmt.Println(msg)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 匿名函数（立即调用）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    fmt.Println('hi')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 多返回值
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func div(a int, b int) (int, string) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a / b, ''
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 命名返回值
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func named() (result int) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    result = 1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 函数赋值给变量
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">f := func(a int) int { 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a * a
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var result = f(10)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>
</div>
<h3>3.6 defer语句</h3>
<ul>
<li data-pid="PQa6Icbg"><code>defer</code>&nbsp;语句在这里是在<strong>语句块结束时执行</strong>，与go原生语言不一样，go原生语言是在函数退出时执行</li>
<li data-pid="MYIR5lK0">多个&nbsp;<code>defer</code>&nbsp;按后进先出（LIFO）顺序执行</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">import 'fmt'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func work() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    defer fmt.Println('deferred')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    fmt.Println('body')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">输出：
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">body
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">deferred
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>3.7 go语句</h3>
<p data-pid="bts0xrwo"><code>go</code>&nbsp;语句用于启动一个并发调用</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">import 'fmt'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go func() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    fmt.Println('in goroutine')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>
</div>
<h3>3.8 数组与切片</h3>
<p>1）固定长度数组：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">[长度]类型{元素列表}</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>2）自动推断长度：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">[...]类型{元素列表}</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>3）多维数组：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">[长度1][长度2]类型{ {元素列表1}, {元素列表2} }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>4）切片：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">[]类型{元素列表}</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 固定长度数组
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var a = [5]int{1,2,3,4,5}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 自动推断长度
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var b = [...]int{1,2,3,4,5}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 切片
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var c = []int{1,2,3,4,5}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 空数组 / 空切片
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var d = [5]int{}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var e = []int{}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// make 创建切片
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var f = make([]int, 5, 10)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 下标访问与赋值
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a[0] = 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 切片表达式
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var g = c[1:3]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var h = c[:2]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var i = c[2:]
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 二维数组
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var m = [2][3]int{{1,2,3},{4,5,6}}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">m[1][2] = 100
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 遍历
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for i, v := range a {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li data-pid="8gM_rd8n">数组是值类型：赋值或传参时会拷贝整个数组</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var b = [5]int{1,2,3,4,5}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var c = b
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">c[0] = 10      // b[0] 仍为 1
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 通过数组指针传递引用
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var d = &amp;b
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">d[0] = 10      // b[0] 变为 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func setarr(x *[5]int) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    x[0] = 100
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var arr = [5]int{1,2,3,4,5}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">setarr(&amp;arr)   // arr[0] 变为 100
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>

<h3>3.9 map</h3>
<p data-pid="rGCaPfgw">无序的键值对集合：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">map[键类型]值类型{键值对列表}</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var m = map[string]int{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    'apple': 1,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    'banana': 2,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    'orange': 3,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// make 创建
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var m = make(map[string]int)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 访问与赋值
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">m['apple'] = 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var v = m['apple']
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 取值并判断是否存在
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">val, ok := m['apple']
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 删除
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">delete(m, 'apple')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 长度
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var n = len(m)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 遍历
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">for k, v := range m {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>

<h3>3.10 结构体</h3>
<p>1）语法：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">type 名称 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span> { 字段名1 类型 字段名2 类型 ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>2）定义结构体方法：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">func (变量 结构体名称) 方法名(参数列表) 返回类型 { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>3）如果方法内要改为对象中的数据，必须定义指针结构体变量：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">func (变量 *结构体名称) 方法名(参数列表) 返回类型 { ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<p>4）结构体实例化：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> 变量 = 结构体名称 { 字段1: 值, 字段2: 值, ... }</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">type Person struct {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    name string
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    age int
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 定义方法
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func (p Person) GetAge() int {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return p.age
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 指针
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func (p *Person) SetAge(age int) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    p.age = age
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 创建实例
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var p = Person{}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 带初始值创建
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var q = Person{name: 'John', age: 20}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 字段访问与赋值
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">q.age = 25
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 调用方法
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">q.SetAge(28)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>
</div>
<h3>3.11 指针</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var a = 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 取地址
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var p = &amp;a
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 解引用
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var v = *p
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 通过指针赋值：a变为20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*p = 20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 带类型的指针
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var i int = 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var pi *int = &amp;i
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 多级指针
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var pp = &amp;p
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var vv = **pp
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>
</div>
<h3>3.12 import</h3>
<p data-pid="Lii1JYh9">导入模块，优先检索内置模块，再检索目录中的文件模块。</p>
<p data-pid="Lii1JYh9">1）导入单个模块：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">import <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模块名</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span></span>&nbsp;</p>
<p data-pid="Lii1JYh9">2）导入多个模块：&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">import (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模块1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">模块2</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> ...)</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">import 'fmt' // 导入单个模块
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">import ('fmt' 'strconv') // 导入多个模块
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fmt.Println('hello')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">strconv.Atoi('123')
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> script.Eval(s);</pre>
</div>
<p>更多模块（fmt、strconv、sync、regexp、time）功能请参考go原生语法。</p>
<h3>3.13 导入文件模块</h3>
<p data-pid="RZ7WeGww">创建模块文件：<code>./modules/Person.go</code></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Person.go</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">type</span> Person <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">struct</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     name <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     age <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">func</span> (p Person) GetAge() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> p.age
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">func</span> (p *Person) SetAge(age <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     p.age =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> age
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>在上下文模块管理中添加&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">./modules</span>&nbsp;目录</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">// 从./modules目录中检索模块并导入
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">import 'Person'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var p = Person{name: 'John', age: 20}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p.SetAge(30)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加modules目录</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> script.Context.Modules.AddDir(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">./modules</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">John</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p.name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p.GetAge()</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h2>四、与宿主程序交互</h2>
<h3>4.1 脚本调用宿主函数</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var x, y = 1, 2
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(x, y)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> script.Context.AddFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (a, b) =&gt; a +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h3>4.2 脚本调用宿主变量</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var x = 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x + y
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> script.Context.SetVar(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">y</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h3>4.3 宿主调用脚本函数</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">func add(a int, b int) int {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a + b
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> f = script.Context.GetFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">add</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>, f(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h3>4.4 宿主调用脚本变量</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var x = 10
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var y = x + 20
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> script.Context.Lang = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">go</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">script.Eval(s);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> y = script.Context.EvalVar&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">y</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>, y);</pre>
</div>
<h2>五、结束语</h2>
